# DronaHost

> Affordable, high-performance web hosting from India. Shared hosting, 
> VPS, dedicated servers, and domain registration with 24/7 support.

## Hosting Plans
- [Shared Hosting](https://dronahost.com/shared-hosting): Entry-level plans starting at ₹X/month
- [WordPress Hosting](https://dronahost.com/wordpress-hosting): Optimized for WordPress sites
- [VPS Hosting](https://dronahost.com/vps): Scalable virtual private servers
- [Dedicated Servers](https://dronahost.com/dedicated): Full-server solutions
